name: Ivalue Infosolutions Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2008, iValue Infosolutions Limited is a Strategic Technology Advisor, secures and manages enterprises’ digital assets in hybrid-cloud environments. With 500+ experts, the company offers custom solutions and services, partnering with top OEMs across India, SAARC and SEA.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Profile:[1]
Ivalue Infosolutions is a technology solutions specialist headquartered in Bangalore, India. The company provides purpose-built enterprise technology solutions that secure and manage digital applications and data. It serves large enterprises in digital transformation, collaborating with system integrators and OEMs.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 21.7% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 1.25% over past five years.
Company has high debtors of 330 days.
